2609.08267.title: Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2609.08267.paper_summary: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model's pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model's parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. To address RHD, we propose a novel method Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification (EAEV), which detects entity-level hallucinations by leveraging RAG to align generated entities with retrieved evidence contexts. Specifically, EAEV evaluates entity-evidence alignment through three complementary dimensions and introduces counterfactual stability analysis to ensure robust alignments under evidence perturbations. Experiments across multiple RAG benchmarks demonstrate that EAEV achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with strong generalization capabilities.
2609.08267.paper_summary_zh: 幻覺檢測對於大型語言模型 (LLMs) 至關重要，因為幻覺內容在需要事實準確性的應用中造成了重大障礙。當前的檢測方法主要依賴於內部信號，如不確定性和自我一致性檢查，利用模型的預訓練知識來識別不可靠的輸出。然而，預訓練知識可能會過時，並且在專業或最新信息方面存在覆蓋限制。為了解決這些限制，檢索增強生成 (RAG) 作為一種有前景的解決方案出現，通過在推理時檢索相關證據，將輸出基於模型的參數知識進行擴展。在本文中，我們針對一個關鍵且實用的學習問題，即基於 RAG 的幻覺檢測 (RHD)，在此情況下，RAG 被用來通過解決信息更新挑戰來增強幻覺檢測。為了解決 RHD，我們提出了一種新方法——證據對齊實體驗證 (EAEV)，該方法通過利用 RAG 將生成的實體與檢索的證據上下文對齊來檢測實體級別的幻覺。具體而言，EAEV 通過三個互補維度評估實體與證據的對齊，並引入反事實穩定性分析，以確保在證據擾動下的穩健對齊。在多個 RAG 基準上的實驗顯示，EAEV 在現有方法上實現了一致的改進，並具有強大的泛化能力。
